method: Read existing job logs and exact-commit source; no project execution, rerun, source/remote write or new service. Count only exact named '.. ok' lines whose test functions and assertions were read. Cargo stdout/stderr headers interleave, so crate/source attribution uses exact source namespaces, not the nearest Running header. Log line ordinals refer to the decoded job log, not GitHub step anchors. Test source references use F#:line; F# resolves to the immutable file URL and Git blob listed in source_files.

finding.interpretation: Positive exact-commit execution evidence for the mapped pure/shared-core obligations, independently of the fixed-82 plan. These 51 named unit functions are not 51 additional disjoint corpus scenarios and must not be added to the 82-case count. Not an overall Stage2 acceptance verdict.

matrix.obligation: Shared coordinator validates the complete effect, retained preparation and fence before consuming or upgrading state
matrix.established: Direct shared-core assertions mutate ten guard fields, correlation/kind, fifteen observation fields, and prepared scope/fence/receipt; wrong delivery preserves state, valid delivery succeeds once, repeats are monotone or rejected. AlreadyAccepted binds the request fence without requiring the old stored token.
matrix.limit: Finite in-memory typed coordinator cases; not real database commit, task ownership or exhaustive generation.

matrix.obligation: Distinguish precommit failure, commit uncertainty, retained receipt and dropped continuation
matrix.established: Guard-only versus reservation Unknown remains distinct; cancellation before completion leaves Waiting/AwaitingCompletion and no manufactured result; a positive receipt or prospective reservation survives an actually dropped synthetic future.
matrix.limit: The Rust service witness adapter is exercised, but this does not qualify production outer ownership or real connection/process cancellation (Stage 3/5).

matrix.obligation: Caller knowledge retains correlated alternatives and proof/sequence/fence ambiguity instead of selecting the injected world
matrix.established: Both earlier worlds survive a later confirmed reservation; all four injected two-Unknown masks retain four possible states; no-commit/cancel does not choose a world; TTL narrows active counts without deleting history. A missing proof stops as KnowledgeModelIncomplete despite actual Completed/ReceiptKnown. Equal occupancy does not merge distinct proofs, sequences or fences, and inconsistent observations preserve old views.
matrix.limit: Finite controlled model and direct helper calls; not arbitrary real SQL state or a universal proof of all schedules.

matrix.obligation: Stop within bounded evidence/view budgets while retaining an observed failure and incomplete classification
matrix.established: A one-event budget yields an empty bounded projection and Inconclusive. A seventh Unknown stops after a 64-view prefix without fabricating bounds. Active=4097 safety failure at index zero remains recorded even when its detail is omitted. The maximal root preserves all summary classes within its constant bound.
matrix.limit: Evidence/model bounds only; not OS wall time, RAM/CPU/process-group supervision or all first-failure precedence paths.

matrix.obligation: Project actual coordinator state and unmapped material instead of reconstructing success from a saved cut
matrix.established: Identical input projects different actual Completed/ReceiptPreserved/Unknown states; unmapped correlation/fence material remains visibly unmapped; rejected undelivered error results leave AwaitingCompletion/Inconclusive.
matrix.limit: Tests call controlled Rust projection directly; independent Python oracle, disk capture and external worker transport need separate evidence.

matrix.obligation: Bind each delivered reconcile observation to its exact effect, unresolved target, fence and observed-at sample
matrix.established: Twelve altered inner-effect fields reject before consumption. All five reconcile classifications retain the supplied sample; microsecond lease/retention boundaries are independent. Actual returned time differing from scripted input drives delivered projection, filtering and caller counts; undelivered data cannot filter views or rewrite prior Unknown history. The service mock returns sample 123456 and the exact request.
matrix.limit: Repository is synthetic/mocked; no actual SQL snapshot/sample atomicity, wire transport or production reconcile caller is qualified here.

matrix.obligation: Reject malformed/saved request inputs and replay stale deliveries without consuming the valid completion
matrix.established: Saved guard mismatch then valid then duplicate produces Request/AlreadyCompleted with preserved state. Missing valid delivery never qualifies terminal. Unknown/duplicate fields and omitted explicit nulls reject; changed finalize fence cannot gain receipt authority; oversize payload is rejected before ownership conversion. Pure transaction predicates cover actor/payload identity, duplicate rows, millisecond rounding, replay/finalize and distinct capacity/expiry thresholds.
matrix.limit: These are in-memory saved values and pure predicates, not the CLI replay binary or full fixed-82 corpus execution; no SQL lock/cleanup conformance is inferred.

matrix.obligation: Consume shared results only with required receipt knowledge while preserving busy/Unknown classification and redaction
matrix.established: Fabricated receipt-free success is rejected; memory denial requires none. Service mock modes preserve Proceed/Conflict/Busy/Unknown, retain the prepared reservation in Unknown and redact private sentinel payloads.
matrix.limit: A real service wrapper with fake Repository modes; not production task ownership or real PostgreSQL/wire behavior.

excluded.unrelated: Other namespaces (MUC, upload, cluster, operation journal, TLS, etc.) and the harness's generic process/readiness/socket helpers are not counted. The replay CLI target reports zero tests; compiling that target is not execution acceptance.

remaining_gaps: Real PostgreSQL reconcile observed_at/snapshot semantics and row/lock/cleanup conformance are not established by mocked repository/pure transaction tests.
Production outer ownership, task lifecycle, real SQL/wire and connection/process cancellation remain Stage3/5 obligations.
This job is Rust-only; Python oracle/shrinker/supervisor and the separately recorded 113 pure/mock suite need their own evidence.
Saved evidence-reader tamper rejection, including v2, is not established by these Rust tests. It needs separate exact-source execution evidence.
No claim is made here that the fixed82 capture/replay campaign or all clock/resource combinations ran or passed.
A coverage matrix is evidence for an independent acceptance decision, not acceptance itself.
privacy: Only exact public test-status lines, source links/hashes and scoped summaries; no full raw logs, credentials, random runtime paths or duplicate 33-job list.
